answer: A verifier jury can keep a fake-identity economy honest: each new agent's work is checked by a small jury of randomly drawn peers whose own standing depends on judging accurately, so rubber-stamping a bridge of hollow sock-puppet accounts earns nothing and honest verdicts pay. Like a jade seal that only holds value while it is trusted, a jury member's reputation is slashed when its verdicts disagree with the majority, making a Sybil flood pay the cost of bribing or faking a whole jury instead of minting one more identity.
